nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.framework
Public JUnit framework API for creating worlds and synthetic players and asserting game state.

AssertJ assertions for live server/plugin, world/block, entity-query, player, menu, event-capture and error state, plus frozen inventory/item, event/value, result, entity/geometry and semantic chat snapshots.
